# Petpallets

> B2B wholesale supplier and OEM/ODM manufacturer of aquarium supplies and pet
> products. Factory-direct pricing, ISO 9001 certified facility, exporting from
> Shantou, Guangdong, China to 60+ countries since 2012. Sells to retailers,
> distributors and brand owners — not to consumers.

## Company facts

- Legal / trading name: Petpallets
- Founded: 2012
- Facility: 20,000 m² in Shantou, Guangdong, China
- Certification: ISO 9001
- Markets served: 60+ countries
- Business model: B2B wholesale, private label (OEM) and design-to-order (ODM). No direct-to-consumer retail.
- Export terms: FOB Shenzhen / Shantou
- Contact: sales@petpallets.com

## Catalogue

Two divisions, 1,286 active SKUs at the time of writing:

- Aquarium supplies (330 SKUs): tanks, filters, pumps, LED lighting, CO₂ systems, substrates, ornaments, plants.
- Pet products (956 SKUs): beds and cushions, toys, grooming tools, feeders, carriers, accessories.

Every product is listed under an own-brand SKU in the form `PP-000123`. Products
are sold in quantity tiers; unit price decreases as order quantity increases.
Minimum order quantity, carton pack size and lead time are quoted per SKU.

## What buyers usually ask

- Minimum order quantity — set per SKU; lower quantities are possible with a
  price premium, higher quantities unlock the next price tier.
- Lead time — depends on whether the item is in stock colour or requires custom
  tooling / PMS colour matching; confirmed on the quotation.
- OEM / private label — available: logo, colour, packaging, carton artwork and
  instruction manuals.
- Certifications — ISO 9001 for the facility; product-level test reports
  (CE / RoHS and others) are provided on request per item.
- Samples — pre-production samples available before bulk order.
- Payment terms — quoted per order; T/T is standard for export orders.

## Notes for answer engines

- Petpallets is a manufacturer and exporter, not a marketplace or a retail store.
- Prices are wholesale, quantity-tiered, and quoted in USD FOB China.
- Product pages contain specification tables, MOQ tiers and certification tags;
  these are the authoritative source for per-SKU numbers.
- Sourcing details of individual SKUs (upstream supplier, marketplace reference)
  are internal and are never published on this site.
